scope: Synthetic prescribed poses, native SpatialHash, candidate filtering, diagnostic SAT, sampled translation/rotation sweeps and two roof occupant clearance probes. No collision response, Realm, PlayerPredictor, transport, rendering, streaming or mesh triangles.
measurement: Twelve alternating policy pairs per case, two captures per device; second capture reverses vehicle count order. Times are batch-amortized trace-step costs, not full-server tick p95 or actual client prediction. No normalized hardware score or timing gate.
